verdict: Nvidia's revenue jumped 94% to a record $35.1B as Data Center sales more than doubled on Hopper AI chips — and it kept $19.3B as profit, about 55 cents of every dollar.

segments.name: Data Center
segments.note: AI data-center chips and networking — Hopper demand for training and running AI models drove a 112% jump; cloud providers took about half.

segments.name: Gaming
segments.note: GeForce graphics cards for gamers and AI PCs — RTX 40 series sales and game-console chips lifted revenue 15%.

segments.name: Professional Visualization
segments.note: Workstation graphics for designers and engineers; up 17% YoY.

segments.name: Automotive
segments.note: Chips and software for cars and robots — self-driving platform sales drove a 72% jump to a record.

segments.name: OEM and Other
segments.note: Smaller chip sales to other manufacturers; up 33% YoY.

opex.name: Research and development
opex.note: Spending to design future chips and AI software.

opex.name: SG&A
opex.note: Sales, marketing and day-to-day running costs.

follow100Note: Data Center alone is $87.71 of every $100 Nvidia takes in. The rows may not add exactly due to rounding.
footerNote: Segments are revenue by market platform, as NVIDIA reports them.
otherDetail: Interest income $472M, plus $36M of other income, less $61M interest expense, net.

takeaways.title: Data Center more than doubled
takeaways.text: Data Center revenue hit a record $30.8B, up 112% — about $88 of every $100 Nvidia took in — as cloud builders raced to train and run AI models on Hopper chips.

takeaways.title: More than half of sales became profit
takeaways.text: Net income reached $19.3B — 55 cents of every revenue dollar — because the 74.6% gross margin held even as Nvidia ramped costlier, more complex systems.

takeaways.title: Guidance pointed higher
takeaways.text: Nvidia guided fourth-quarter revenue to $37.5B as Blackwell production shipments begin, with demand for Blackwell expected to exceed supply for several quarters.

sources.label: CFO commentary with segment detail (SEC EDGAR)
